description_en: Reboots a batch of specified resources for associated events, either immediately or at a scheduled time
description_zh: 用于批量立即或预约重启指定资源的事件
kebab_example: aliyun ens batch-event-reboot-instance --event-infos ResourceId=n-54hi3ffi63zrjt4wzx9mepeyh EventId=e-4452cec5a8f8eb9b2879a054207687d6 PlanUtcTime=example-string OpsType=immediate PlanTime=1742452232000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchEventRebootInstance

parameters.description_en: A list of objects, where each object specifies an Event and the associated Resource to reboot.

element_fields.description_en: The ID of the System Event.

element_fields.description_en: The ID of the Resource to be rebooted.

element_fields.description_en: The scheduled execution time, specified as a Timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when `OpsType` is `scheduled`.
